dead_ship_passwords.name: Dead Ship Passwords
dead_ship_passwords.desc: You've opened enough dead ships to guess what a tired engineer would type. +1 Hacking, and better tools in Hacking check windows, as if you were one tier better.

sealant_and_prayer.name: Sealant and Prayer
sealant_and_prayer.desc: You've kept reactors running on less than anyone thought possible. +1 Engineering, and better tools in Engineering check windows, as if you were one tier better.

read_the_footnotes.name: Read the Footnotes
read_the_footnotes.desc: Everyone who knew the answers is dead, so you've learned to read what they left behind. +1 Lore, and better tools in Science and Lore check windows, as if you were one tier better.

who_can_wait.name: Who Can Wait
who_can_wait.desc: You've learned to hold three emergencies in your head at once, and to know which one can wait. Stress builds 10% slower, and you get better tools in Medicine, Survival and Composure check windows, as if you were one tier better.

dont_slow_down.name: Don't Slow Down
dont_slow_down.desc: You've flown through wreckage and run through burning decks, and the trick is the same. +2 to escape fights, and better tools in Piloting and Athletics check windows, as if you were one tier better.

between_the_searchlights.name: Between the Searchlights
between_the_searchlights.desc: You've crossed enough hulls and patrol lines to see the gaps in them. +1 on checks in vacuum and in the dark, and better tools in Void Ops and Stealth check windows, as if you were one tier better.

one_working_cannon.name: One Working Cannon
one_working_cannon.desc: You've fought a war with one good gun, and you've learned to put the shot where they're going to be. +1 Gunnery, and better tools in Gunnery and Firearms check windows, as if you were one tier better.

the_second_move.name: The Second Move
the_second_move.desc: You've learned that the first thing anyone shows you is a feint, whether it's a blade or a battle line. +1 Melee, and better tools in Melee and Tactics check windows, as if you were one tier better.

the_bad_route.name: The Bad Route
the_bad_route.desc: The safe lanes are watched, so you've learned to plot what nobody else would try. +1 Navigation, and better tools in Navigation check windows, as if you were one tier better.

last_officer_standing.name: Last Officer Standing
last_officer_standing.desc: You got the chair because everyone above you died, and you've learned to read a room that knows it. +1 Leadership, and better tools in Persuasion, Leadership and Streetwise check windows, as if you were one tier better.

two_sets_of_books.name: Two Sets of Books
two_sets_of_books.desc: You keep one story for the council, and another for what really happened. +1 Deception, and better tools in Deception check windows, as if you were one tier better.

nobody_asks_twice.name: Nobody Asks Twice
nobody_asks_twice.desc: You've given orders nobody wanted to hear, and you know what your silence does to a room. +1 Intimidation, and better tools in Intimidation check windows, as if you were one tier better.

knows_the_price.name: Knows the Price
knows_the_price.desc: Resonance always costs something, and you've learned to stop just short of what you can't pay. +2 maximum energy, and better tools in Manifestation check windows, as if you were one tier better.

weighs_every_promise.name: Weighs Every Promise
weighs_every_promise.desc: You've picked up the Korrun habit of weighing what people say before you pay for it. Market prices are 5% better, and you get better tools in Commerce check windows, as if you were one tier better.

counts_the_exits.name: Counts the Exits
counts_the_exits.desc: You walk into every room checking what's changed, and how you'd get out. +1 Awareness, and better tools in Awareness check windows, as if you were one tier better.

listens_past_the_hum.name: Listens Past the Hum
listens_past_the_hum.desc: You've sat with the hum for long enough to hear the shape of what's underneath it. +1 Attunement, and better tools in Attunement check windows, as if you were one tier better.

not_their_face.name: Not Their Face
not_their_face.desc: You've learned to look at a face you loved and keep your hands steady. +2 on checks and attack rolls against the Choir.

read_the_names.name: Read the Names
read_the_names.desc: You've read out enough names at enough funerals to know how to carry them afterward. Stress fades 25% faster.

reads_the_fine_print.name: Reads the Fine Print
reads_the_fine_print.desc: You've read enough Hegemony contracts to fear the kindest clause most. +2 on checks and attack rolls against the Hegemony, and +1 when facing authority.

learned_the_hard_way.name: Learned the Hard Way
learned_the_hard_way.desc: Every mistake since the Fall has cost someone something, so you don't make them twice. All skills improve 15% faster.

make_it_count.name: Make It Count
make_it_count.desc: Ammunition is rationed now, and so are second chances. +1 damage with every weapon.

still_here.name: Still Here
still_here.desc: You've been listed among the dead twice so far, and both times the paperwork was wrong. +8 maximum health, and fatigue builds 10% slower.
